entities.name: C3a
observations: Recombinant C3a significantly increased proliferation of human dental pulp stem cells and pulp fibroblasts in vitro; in a microfluidic C3a gradient it mobilized DPSCs but specifically recruited pulp fibroblasts.
C3a receptor expression was detected in cultured pulp fibroblasts, STRO-1-sorted DPSCs, and human tooth sections by immunofluorescence and RT-PCR.

entities.name: Dental pulp stem cells
observations: In a human dental pulp study, C3a mobilized DPSCs in a gradient but did not specifically recruit them directionally.
DPSCs expressed C3aR/C3AR1 in cultured cells and human tooth sections.

entities.name: Pulp fibroblasts
observations: In a human dental pulp study, a C3a gradient specifically recruited pulp fibroblasts, distinguishing them from DPSCs.
Pulp fibroblasts expressed C3aR/C3AR1 in cultured cells and human tooth sections.

entities.name: PMID:27497510
observations: Ghazaryan et al., Journal of Endodontics (2016), directly tested recombinant C3a using proliferation assays and microfluidic chemotaxis chambers in human dental pulp cells and tooth sections.
The study supports DPSC mobilization and specific pulp-fibroblast recruitment, but not specific directional DPSC chemoattraction.
